jobs.description:
Our customer is looking for an Administrator to join the Packaging Department. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring suppliers to ensure their packaging complies with the European Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Monitoring suppliers' compliance with PPWR requirements and ensuring project deadlines are achieved.
 
• Organizing and facilitating online meetings with suppliers.
 
• Advising suppliers on packaging types, responsibilities, and compliance expectations.
 
• Explaining regulatory requirements and guiding suppliers through implementation plans.
 
• Coordinating action plans and establishing clear timelines and milestones.
 
• Following up on corrective actions and tracking supplier progress.
 
• Preparing weekly compliance and progress reports for management.
 
• Escalating risks, concerns, and non-compliance issues when necessary.
 
• Conducting compliance checks and audits on packaging and manufacturer labels within warehouse operations.
 
• Verifying that packaging and labeling activities comply with PPWR regulations and internal quality standards.
 
• Contributing to a sustainable, compliant, and efficient supply chain environment. 

Who are we looking for? 
 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field.
 
• Experience in logistics, compliance, supply chain administration, or project coordination is an asset.
 
• Knowledge of sustainable packaging solutions is considered a strong plus. 
 

 
• Fluent in English.
 
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Access and/or Power BI.
 
• Able to manage multiple suppliers, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
 
• Detail-oriented, accurate, and reliable.
 
• Capable of working independently while maintaining close collaboration with colleagues.
 
• Proactive mindset with strong follow-up skills, analytic, team-oriented, positive, handson.

Are you looking for a stable job in a high-tech production environment where quality, innovation, and teamwork are at the heart of everything? You'll play a key role in maintaining an efficient production process while ensuring the highest quality standards.

• You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.

• You are a team player with a hands-on mentality.

For a food production company, we are looking for motivated flexi workers who can work either a few hours per day or a full day shift.

Your responsibilities

 
• 
Supporting production and packaging activities.

 
• 
Performing repetitive tasks while following quality standards.

 
• 
Working accurately and hygienically in a food production environment.

 
• 
Profile

Repetitive work does not discourage you.

You have no physical complaints or limitations.

You are available during weekdays (1 to 2 days per week is sufficient).

Monday to Thursday: 7:30 AM – 5:00 PM.

Tasks & Responsibilities
 

 
• Monitor supplier compliance with the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
 
• Track project progress and ensure deadlines are met.
 
• Organize and facilitate online meetings with suppliers.
 
• Explain PPWR requirements, compliance expectations, and supplier responsibilities.
 
• Discuss and clarify different packaging types and packaging processes.
 
• Coordinate implementation plans and define target dates.
 
• Follow up on corrective actions and ensure timely execution.
 
• Monitor progress, milestones, and supplier commitments.
 
• Prepare weekly compliance reports for management.
 
• Identify risks, bottlenecks, and areas requiring escalation.
 
• Conduct audits and inspections within warehouse operations.
 
• Verify manufacturer labels and packaging compliance.
 
• Ensure packaging and labeling processes meet PPWR requirements and internal standards.
 
• Collaborate with internal departments and external suppliers.
 
• Contribute to a sustainable, compliant, and efficient supply chain.
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization projects. 

Profile
 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
 
• Experience with sustainable packaging solutions is an asset.
 
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
 
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and SharePoint.
 
• Knowledge of Access and Power BI is a plus.
 
• Able to manage multiple suppliers, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.

• Accurate, structured, and detail-oriented.
 
• Able to work independently while maintaining a proactive approach.
 
• Analytical and capable of making fact-based decisions.
 
• Strong follow-up skills and a results-driven mindset.
 
• Positive attitude combined with a strong work ethic.
 
• Team player who values collaboration and respect.
 
• Eager to learn and continuously improve processes.

Location : Belgium

Start date : ASAP

Duration : 3 - 6 months + extension(s)
Senior IT Project Manager - workforce management application

We are looking for a Senior IT Project Manager to lead a Workforce Management project, covering the analysis of RFP responses and the implementation of an application delivered by an external supplier.

The solution will support employee scheduling, working time management and employee evaluations.

You will coordinate HR stakeholders, IT teams, Procurement and external partners throughout supplier evaluation, implementation and rollout. Knowledge of HR processes and experience delivering a similar project are highly desirable.
Description

• 
RFP analysis & supplier evaluation: Analyse supplier proposals against business and technical requirements, compare implementation approaches, identify gaps and risks, and support supplier selection.

• 
Project management: Lead the full project lifecycle, managing scope, planning, budget, resources, quality and change.

• 
Business & IT coordination: Work with HR stakeholders, Business Analysts and technical teams to clarify requirements and ensure the solution meets business needs.

• 
Supplier management: Coordinate the selected supplier's activities, monitor commitments and deliverables, and manage dependencies with internal teams.

• 
Application implementation: Oversee configuration, integrations, data migration and deployment of the supplier-delivered application.

• 
Testing & UAT: Coordinate testing and user acceptance with HR and business teams, ensuring issues are addressed before go-live.

Reporting & governance: Prepare weekly status reports, Steering Committee presentations and PMO updates, following established project management standards.

• 
Risk & issue management: Identify risks, track mitigation actions and resolve or escalate issues.

Change & rollout: Coordinate communication, training, business readiness and transition to operational support.

Team leadership: Functionally manage up to five team members, including Business Analysts, developers and testers.

Required skills:

• 
At least 5 years of experience in IT project management in a business or industry environment

• 
Proven experience implementing business applications delivered by external suppliers

• 
Experience analysing RFP responses, evaluating supplier proposals and supporting solution selection

• 
Strong supplier management and coordination skills

• 
PMP, Prince2 or equivalent project management certification

• 
Strong stakeholder management, communication and executive reporting skills

• 
Experience managing budgets, planning, risks and project dependencies

• 
Ability to lead projects independently and coordinate business and technical teams

 

Preferred experience:

• 
Previous implementation of a Workforce Management solution or a similar HR application

• 
Knowledge of HR processes, particularly workforce planning, employee scheduling, time and attendance, and employee evaluations

• 
Experience with application integrations and data migration

• 
SAP knowledge is a strong plus

• 
A retail/Supply background is an asset

 

Education & languages:

• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or equivalent

• 
Good understanding of current and emerging technologies

• 
Native French or Dutch required, combined with Fluent English

jobs.description:
Opportunity

Ensure the quality and reliability of our Defense Platform which offers a complete in-service support lifecycle for materials, consumables, and repairable items within defense organizations.You focus on validating Enterprise Suite functionalities, testing APIs, and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven EnvironmentYour work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.The Impact You Help CreateYou improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. Your work supports consistent and trustworthy outcomes.

Your Mission

What you will do:

• Design, execute, and maintain detailed test plans and test cases covering functional and non-functional testing
• Perform API testing
• Perform integration, regression, and end-to-end testing activities
• Identify, document, and track defects
• Support test documentation and reporting
• Work with development teams to resolve issues and improve quality
• Contribute to structured testing processes and continuous improvement
• Support automated testing activities

What You Bring

• Experience in manual and functional testing
• Strong experience with API testing
• Proven experience using Postman
• Understanding of testing methodologies (ISTQB foundation level or similar knowledge)
• Experience with test and defect management tools such as Jira, Spira, Xray, or similar
• Knowledge of test automation tools such as Playwright or equivalent
• Analytical mindset and attention to detail
• Strong communication skills in English
• Ability to work independently and within a team
Systems Thinking and Analytical StrengthYou understand how business processes, application functionality, APIs, and system behavior connect. You analyze outcomes and ensure that applications perform consistently across scenarios.Working Across Teams and FunctionsYou work with developers, analysts, and others stakeholders. You support collaboration and ensure that quality is maintained across the development process.

Responsibilities

• Design pragmatic and sustainable end-to-end solutions that align with business requirements and IT architecture standards.
• Translate complex business needs into robust technical specifications and architectural designs.
• Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to foster consensus and drive alignment from project inception to production.
• Define short, medium, and long-term visions for IT system development within a hybrid environment of legacy and modern technologies.
• Present architectural solutions to the governance board and maintain high-quality documentation.
• Validate solutions with technical teams while considering implementation costs and long-term maintainability.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in solution architecture and functional design.
• You possess deep knowledge of Domain Driven Design (DDD) concepts and asynchronous integration patterns.
• You have experience navigating hybrid IT landscapes, specifically transitioning from legacy environments to modern stacks.
• You're proactive, creative, and capable of synthesizing large amounts of complex information.
• You are fluent in English with fluency in either Dutch or French and at least basic knowledge of the other.
Nice to Haves

• Experience in the life insurance sector.
• Knowledge of ArchiMate for architectural modeling.
• Familiarity with .NET, Angular, or COBOL environments.
• Willingness to explore and implement technological innovations in critical systems.

Opportunity

This is an office-based role. Candidates are expected to work from our office at least 4 days per week. Remote work is limited to 1 day per week.

Building reliable infrastructure from the inside

Reliable infrastructure is about more than keeping systems running. It means understanding how an environment works, solving problems at their source and creating systems that become easier to manage over time.As a System Engineer at ILIAS Solutions, you take ownership of the infrastructure behind our international organization. This is an internal IT position: you will not work directly with customers, but you will support the people who build, deliver, implement and support the ILIAS Defense Platform.You work across Linux systems, hybrid infrastructure and automation. Alongside day-to-day operations, you look for patterns: where recurring work can be automated, where configurations can become more consistent and where better documentation can make the environment easier to understand. The goal is clear: continue moving infrastructure from reactive support towards a structured, automated and predictable engineering environment.

Meaningful work

ILIAS develops software for demanding defense and security environments, and the people behind that work depend on reliable technology every day. As part of Internal IT, your impact is internal but reaches across the organization: you help create the technical foundation that enables development teams to build, implementation teams to deliver and support teams to help customers. When infrastructure is stable, secure and well managed, colleagues across Belgium, the Netherlands, Denmark and the United States can work with fewer disruptions and greater confidence.

Your Mission

What will you do?

• Manage and improve the internal server infrastructure that supports ILIAS employees across offices, teams and business functions.
• Take ownership of Linux system administration, including installation, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, patching and performance follow-up.
• Use Ansible to automate recurring work, standardize configurations and make infrastructure changes repeatable, traceable and less dependent on manual execution.
• Maintain Linux and Windows Server environments across VMware, Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
• Investigate complex infrastructure, system, software and network issues with an analytical mindset and a focus on sustainable solutions, not quick fixes only.
• Contribute to clear documentation, monitoring, backup routines, operational procedures and continuous improvement of internal IT processes.
• Support secure and reliable access to the internal systems and infrastructure services used by ILIAS colleagues every day.
• Work with the reliability, quality and security awareness expected from a company active in the defence domain and certified according to ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials.
 

What you bring?

• Proven experience as a Linux System Administrator or System Engineer.
• Strong hands-on expertise in Linux server environments. Linux is not a side topic in this role; it is one of the core areas where we need depth.
• Solid experience with Ansible, including playbooks, automation and configuration management.
• Good knowledge of Azure and experience with cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments.
• Knowledge of VMware and Windows Server environments.
• A security-minded approach to infrastructure and operations.
• Strong analytical thinking skills: you can investigate issues thoroughly, identify root causes and explain your reasoning clearly.
• A predictable and transparent way of working: you document what you do, communicate clearly and keep colleagues informed before, during and after changes.
• The maturity to take ownership, challenge unclear requests, ask the right questions and work towards sustainable improvements.
• A degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• At least C1 level in Dutch and English.

Responsibilities

• Map current operational processes and design future-state operating models across multiple entities.

• Translate functional decisions into technical application requirements, including parameters, data mapping, and access rights.
• Lead workshops with various stakeholders to align local requirements with organizational standards.
• Coordinate with technical teams to implement changes in human resources and operational management systems.

Requirements

• Possess strong expertise in stakeholder management within complex environments involving multiple parties.
• You have experience documenting data models, interfaces, and master data codification.
• You bring experience in designing and executing application test plans and validation strategies.
• 1+ years of experience managing or supporting data migration projects.
• 1+ years of experience working within the public sector.

Nice to Haves

Opportunity
Ensure the quality and reliability of our PLUS Platform .PLUS exists so ILIAS can focus on its core business. We take on the opportunities, challenges, and initiatives that require new thinking, new technology, or a different approach. By carrying part of the innovation, transformation, and operational load, we help the organisation move faster and prepare for what comes next. Adaptability is our superpower. We don't just respond to change, we work where ILIAS will be tomorrow.You focus on validating PLUS functionalities and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven EnvironmentYour work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.The Impact You Help CreateYou improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building secure cloud environments and embedding security into every stage of software delivery? In this role, you will help shape a security-first culture by integrating security into development processes, strengthening cloud environments, and enabling teams to deliver resilient applications at scale.

What you'll do

• You design, build and maintain automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring security is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Working closely with development, cloud and operations teams, you help implement security-by-design practices across AWS and Azure environments.
• You assess cloud security posture, identify risks and lead remediation efforts to improve compliance with security frameworks and benchmarks.
• You support the security of containerized platforms and infrastructure-as-code solutions by promoting secure configurations and automation.
• You provide expertise on secure coding standards, DevSecOps tooling and application security practices, helping teams strengthen their security maturity.
• By monitoring key security indicators and supporting incident investigations, you contribute to the continuous improvement of Luminus' cyber resilience. 

What you bring

• Proven experience in DevSecOps, cloud security or application security, with a strong understanding of CI/CD environments and security automation.
• Experience working with security technologies such as SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets management solutions, Terraform and software supply chain security practices.
• Strong knowledge of cloud and container technologies, including AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and related security concepts.
• Your understanding of application security principles, OWASP guidelines and vulnerability management enables you to identify and address security risks effectively.
• A collaborative mindset that allows you to work effectively with developers, cloud experts, project teams and external partners.
• Professional proficiency in English and fluency in Dutch and/or French.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You prepare and submit certification files to national authorities and certification bodies.
• You analyze quality standards, norms, customer specifications, contracts and aviation regulations and adapt internal procedures or manuals, or draft new procedures.
• You organize and supervise external audits of customers, authorities and certification organisations and handle the findings.
• You are part of the validation process of suppliers and subcontractors and monitor the process regarding the quality of the delivered products and services.
• You support the owners of the processes in dealing with quality deviations/findings, using quality basic techniques.
• You propose actions to improve the efficiency of the business processes.
• You prepare presentations and provide training to colleagues on quality topics.
• You participate in multidisciplinary projects.
• You conduct internal quality audits, provide reporting of findings and follow up on corrective actions.
• You assist in the statistical analysis of data and its reporting.
• You manage Non-Conformities at the Quality Level:
• Report any non-compliance and/or non-application of quality rules to management.
• Record and monitor quality deviations identified in products and processes, in accordance with the company's quality system.
• Analyze and catalog quality deviations relating to products and processes in order to statistically determine areas for improvement within the company.
• Raise awareness and provide guidance to all staff regarding quality management to ensure product compliance and the effective operation of company processes.
• Provide methodological support to management and/or process owners when addressing quality deviations in their area (using QMS tools).
• Independently validate the root causes of quality deviations as defined by process owners.
• Independently verify the effectiveness of corrective and remedial actions resulting from quality deviations.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, or equivalent through experience.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are analytically and editorially minded.
• You are creative in finding solutions within the established framework.
• You can work independently and are committed to develop your knowledge through self-study and research.
• You are open minded, you work in a structured way and you can motivate people with regards to the quality and safety policy of the company.
• Additional qualifications that may help you in this role (but not a must have) include:
• Experience in quality and safety management in aviation
• Knowledge of standards and guidelines from national and international aviation authorities (EN9110, EASA part 145, etc)
• Knowledge of quality management systems
• Knowledge of aircraft engines, metrology
• Knowledge of process management
• Knowledge and ability to apply quality techniques and methodologies, such as problem solving techniques (8D, Ishikawa, flow charts, , ...), audit techniques.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
